# Bundled instrument sources

The working instruments are bundled for offline use. No subscription, external synthesizer, or Logic installation is required.

- Steinway B piano recordings: Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL), CC0. https://versilian-studios.com/vcsl/ ; https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL
- Electric bass: Karoryfer Black And Blue Basses, Darkblack medium-forte fingerstyle recordings, CC0. https://shop.karoryfer.com/pages/free-samples ; https://github.com/sfzinstruments/karoryfer.black-and-blue-basses
- Orchestra: VSCO 2 Community Edition violin section, cellos, French horn and flute recordings, CC0. https://versilian-studios.com/vsco-community/ ; https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE
- Warm Synth: original Web Audio FM/additive synthesis; no third-party sample license.

Selected source paths and sample roots are recorded in sounds/manifest.json. The recordings are converted to stereo 22,050 Hz, 16-bit PCM, trimmed, normalized and given short edge fades. Bass and orchestral sustain regions have a crossfaded loop; the ensemble combines instruments on the same note, without a prerecorded chord. Steinway is a sampled instrument description, not an endorsement or affiliation.

Threes retains its existing pitch routing and piano mixer proportions. Bass uses its original F2–E3 register, initial volume 20%, a gentle 35 ms attack and 300 ms release. Saved volume choices remain preserved. Infinity defaults to Orchestra, offers Warm Synth, and retains Exact Sine for tuning comparisons. The chosen sound persists. Its existing exact-frequency and audio-clock scheduling remain in use. Time and the opening curtains retain their existing sounds.

Automated scheduling and native playback checks do not establish audible quality or physical Mac sleep/wake reliability. Those require listening to the downloaded app.
